England and Wales inputs for a second demographic transition example

Source: R/data.R
england_wales_1992_onward.Rd

A named list of six tibbles used by the second demographic transition article vignette. Fertility and marriage tables have Hammel's schedule column names; cohabitation and marital divorce/death observations retain source values for the article's transformation examples. Cohabitation cohort outcomes cover Great Britain; the other tables cover England and Wales.

Usage

england_wales_1992_onward

Format

A named list containing:

fertility

18 rows: union_type, age_start, age_end, rate.

marriage

672 rows: time_start, time_end, age_start, age_end, previous_union, rate.

premarital_cohabitation

373 rows: year, age_groups, prop_cohabit.

cohabitation_outcomes

3 rows: cohort_start, cohort_end, marriage_5, separation_5, continuing_5, marriage_10, separation_10, continuing_10.

marital_divorce_death_2005

52 rows: year, anniversary, cumulative_divorce, cumulative_death.

marital_divorce_death_2010

60 rows, with the same columns as 2005.

Ages, durations and calendar times are in years. Rates are annual; proportions are on the zero-to-one scale. Source cohorts are half-open intervals, not calendar periods of a rate schedule.

Source

Office for National Statistics (ONS). Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0: https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/

Fertility: O'Leary L, Natamba E, Jefferies J, Wilson B (2010). Fertility and partnership status in the last two decades. Population Trends 140, Table B1. doi:10.1057/pt.2010.10 .

Marriage and premarital cohabitation: ONS Marriages in England and Wales, 2019 workbook; female marital population estimates, 1971–2001 and 2002–2019. Exact source URLs, retrieval dates and checksums are recorded in the repository's source-folder sources.csv.

Cohabitation outcomes: Beaujouan E, Ni Bhrolchain M (2011). Cohabitation and marriage in Britain since the 1970s. Population Trends 145, Table 3. doi:10.1057/pt.2011.16 .

Marital divorce/death, 2005: Wilson B, Smallwood S (2008). The proportion of marriages ending in divorce. Population Trends 131, Table 3; cumulative proportions reconstructed from life-table event counts. Marital divorce/death, 2010: ONS Divorces in England and Wales, 2012 bulletin, Figure 5. Publication tables and PDFs are not bundled with this dataset.

Details

Fertility rates are births per woman-year in 1992 by union_type: "marriage", "cohab" and "unpartnered". Age bounds use the source's denominator ages, 16–45.

Marriage rates are annual central rates of first marriages and remarriages for 1992–2019. previous_union maps these to "none" and "dissolved"; this describes legal marital history, not prior cohabitation. Calendar intervals are [time_start, time_end). The 48 unavailable rates remain NA. These marriage observations are not direct measurements of union-entry hazards including cohabitation.

Premarital cohabitation proportions condition on marrying; Cohabitation outcomes are cumulative proportions at five and ten years for women under 45 at cohabitation start. Source rounding and missing ten-year values for the latest cohort are retained.

Marital divorce/death tables are cumulative competing-risk proportions, not annual hazards. No hazard conversion, normalization, extrapolation or interpolation is applied to these tables.

Original numerical sources and their provenance remain in validation/data/england_wales_1992_onward/ in the repository. The offline preparation script is data-raw/england_wales_1992_onward.R.
